Group several together to tell a festive story on the lawn, use them to frame the front door or path, or place one where it can be seen from the window so the whole family can enjoy it from inside too. Pair it with other MySmartBuy light up figures, trees and wreaths to build a full festive display that neighbours, visitors and passers-by will love. 8956086258427.sourceDescription:
Add a rich festive finish to your tree with this set of 24 deep red velvet Christmas bows. Each bow is made from thick, soft velvet with a gentle sheen, so it catches the light without looking flashy. The classic two loop shape gives a vintage, elegant feel that suits both traditional and modern schemes, and the deep red stands out beautifully against green branches, warm white lights and natural pine cones.

Each bow measures about 5 in wide and 7 in long and is made from 3/8 in wide velvet ribbon. The neat, compact size works on real and artificial trees alike, and 24 bows are enough to dress a full sized tree, a garland or a matching set of wreaths. The velvet holds its shape well, so the loops stay full instead of collapsing after a few days on display, and the ribbon keeps a soft, smooth touch.

Use them on Christmas trees, wreaths, garlands, gift wrapping, stockings and table decorations, or tie them to chair backs and staircase rails for a coordinated look. For extra stability, secure each bow with a clip or a little extra string, and keep a few spare for last minute gift wrapping, as the red tone works as well on kraft paper as it does on greenery. When the season is over, store the bows flat in a dry box to keep them free of tangles and creases, ready to use again next year.
Guarantee - 1 month

Product Introduction

 This Solar Santa Projection Wall Light is an outdoor Christmas decorative lamp with warm white lighting. 
 It adopts hollow cut-out design, projecting a delicate warm-white Santa Claus silhouette with snowflake and radial ray patterns onto walls, fences or patio surfaces. 
 Built-in solar panel and light sensor, it absorbs sunlight for charging during daytime and automatically turns on at dusk and off at dawn. No wiring required, zero electricity cost, perfect to create a cozy festive atmosphere for your outdoor space.

Material & Specifications

 Power Supply: Solar powered, built-in rechargeable battery
 Light Color: Warm white
 Projection Pattern: Santa Claus carrying gift bag, snowflakes and radial sunburst rays
 Dimension: 8.5cm × 8.5cm / 3.35in × 3.35in

 Working Time: 6–12 hours after fully charged
 Housing Material: Durable plastic

 Application: Garden, porch, patio, backyard, exterior wall, fence

Application Scenarios
Ideal Christmas outdoor decor for garden walls, porch, patio, fence and backyard. Great for Christmas parties and seasonal holiday display. It can also serve as a lovely holiday gift, casting beautiful warm white Santa projection to welcome Christmas.
Notes

 Place solar panel under direct sunshine to ensure sufficient charging.
 Rated for outdoor use, avoid long-term immersion in standing water.
 Actual working time varies with sunlight intensity and weather.
 Easy wall mount design, no cables or complicated installation.
FESTIVE CHRISTMAS PROJECTION: The Solar Christmas Projector Outdoor Wall Light features intricate cutout designs of Christmas trees, bells, snowflakes, gifts, and seasonal figures, casting decorative shadows across nearby walls, fences, and outdoor gathering areas.
LIGHTING MODES: A cozy warm-white glow for timeless holiday ambiance , add festive character to Christmas parties, family gatherings, and winter evenings.
SOLAR POWERED ILLUMINATION: The integrated solar panel charges in approximately 5–8 hours of direct sunlight and provides about 6–12 hours of lighting, depending on sunlight exposure, weather conditions, and the selected lighting mode—no outdoor wiring required.
AUTOMATIC DUSK-TO-DAWN OPERATION: Position the solar panel in an area with unobstructed sunlight and switch the unit on. After charging, the built-in light sensor automatically activates the illumination at dusk and turns it off during daylight.
IP65 WATERPROOF & FLEXIBLE PLACEMENT: Constructed with a decorative iron housing and an IP65 waterproof design for seasonal outdoor use. Mount it on a wall, fence, or deck post for projected patterns, or place it on a tabletop, porch ledge, or patio as a freestanding holiday accent.

Complete beaded tree set: Includes colorful beads, green branch pieces, decorative ornament charms, metal support parts, an angel topper, a round display base, and a light string, giving you the main materials needed to build a detailed tabletop christmas tree.
